skill.name: douyin-video-copy-extract
skill.description: 用于抖音文案提取、抖音文案一键提取、抖音视频文案提取、抖音视频转文字、抖音口播转文字和抖音逐字稿。用户粘贴抖音视频链接、分享文案或 aweme_id 后，提取视频上下文、原视频简介和口播逐字稿。
skill.summary: Extract original Douyin video descriptions, spoken transcripts, and text ready to copy through SocialDataX.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most backtick, reconnaissance, and entropy alerts match documentation or readable Chinese text. Risks include unpinned CLI execution with access to credentials, unsafe shell argument construction, potentially billable submissions, unbounded polling, and trust in response-supplied payment links. No evidence of embedded secrets or an attempt to manipulate the audit was found.

remediation.issue: Authentication and transcript commands execute an unpinned npm package with access to user credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Pin and review an exact CLI build, require explicit installation approval, and use a least-privilege service credential in an isolated execution environment.

remediation.issue: Shell examples do not define how to bind untrusted inputs safely.
remediation.suggestion: Use a subprocess argument array without a shell, validate IDs, and pass share text and subtitle paths only as argument values.

remediation.issue: Implicit invocation can transmit inputs to a third party and start work that may consume credits.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before a first submission, name the recipient and possible cost, and transmit only the data needed to identify the requested video.

remediation.issue: The polling loop has no time or request cap.
remediation.suggestion: Set request and time limits, clamp provider-provided delays, and return the existing job ID when the limit is reached.

remediation.issue: The billing flow prefers an error-supplied payment link without specifying validation.
remediation.suggestion: Use the fixed HTTPS SocialDataX billing page from the documentation. Do not display a payment link taken from an error response.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Input in CLI Command Templates
semantic_findings.description: The shell examples do not define safe binding for share text, video IDs, or job IDs. Interpolating those values into shell source could let input alter the command.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The examples place placeholders inside shell commands, accept free-form share text, and reuse a service-returned ID. The actual risk depends on how the agent binds arguments.

semantic_findings.title: Implicit Submission Can Share Data and Consume Credits
semantic_findings.description: Implicit invocation can start a third-party transcription job without a separate confirmation step. The workflow accepts full share text and can consume SocialDataX credits.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The policy allows implicit invocation, and the workflow directs immediate submission for a new input. Balance handling confirms credit use is possible, not that every request is charged.

semantic_findings.title: Polling Has No Request or Time Limit
semantic_findings.description: A job that stays pending can keep the agent issuing requests until the tool fails or the user intervenes. A service-supplied delay also has no stated bounds.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The stopping rules list terminal state, tool failure, and user cancellation, with no deadline or request cap. The service controls the suggested delay.

semantic_findings.title: Billing Flow Trusts Links from Error Responses
semantic_findings.description: The workflow prefers a billing link from an error response over the fixed provider page. Without a destination check, a substituted link could misdirect users or their payments.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions call the response link official but provide no origin check. The reviewed files contain no evidence of an actual substituted link.

content.user_title: Extract Douyin Video Descriptions and Transcripts
content.value_statement: Copying a Douyin video description and transcribing its speech by hand takes time. Use SocialDataX to retrieve both and format the result as text you can copy.
actual_capabilities: Submit one Douyin video using a link, share text, or video ID.
Check an existing transcription job by its job ID without submitting the video again.
Return the original description, spoken transcript, and available video details after success.
Format the returned text into a version for copying and a concise summary.
Export an SRT subtitle file with the direct CLI when the service returns valid timed segments.
limitations: The workflow supports Douyin videos only and does not switch platforms after a failure.
SocialDataX requires authentication, and submitting a job may use credits.
Video details and transcripts depend on the service response and are not available for every video.
SRT export requires direct CLI version 0.2.64 or later, valid timing data, and a new file in a writable directory.

best_practices: Provide only the video link or ID needed for the job, and confirm before starting a request that may use credits.
Use an approved CLI build or an authenticated hosted MCP connection, and keep API keys out of chat.
Reuse the job ID after interruptions and verify the destination before exporting subtitles.
anti_patterns: Paste an API key into a chat, command argument, or shared log.
Submit the same video again just to check the status of an existing job.
Invent transcript text, video details, or timestamps when the service does not return them.

faq.question: Which Douyin inputs does the skill accept?
faq.answer: Use a video link, short link, share text, or Douyin video ID. Use a job ID to check an existing transcription.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX account?
faq.answer: The workflow needs an authenticated SocialDataX CLI or hosted MCP connection. Submitting a new job may use account credits.

faq.question: Does the skill log in to Douyin or change my account?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow submits transcription jobs to SocialDataX and does not sign in to Douyin, post, like, or comment.

faq.question: Can I save an SRT subtitle file?
faq.answer: Yes, with direct CLI version 0.2.64 or later and valid timed segments. Choose a new filename in an existing writable directory.

faq.question: What happens if a job is still processing?
faq.answer: The skill checks the same job ID. If you stop or the tool cannot continue, keep the job ID to resume later.

faq.question: Does the transcript include on-screen text?
faq.answer: The workflow documents spoken transcription and the original video description. It does not promise extraction of text visible in the video.
